[Council File 26-1461]
Motion (Hernandez – Padilla, et al.) relative to policy recommendations related to the regulation of algorithmic rent-setting and artificial intelligence technologies utilized by multifamily residential housing providers operating within the City.

None submitted
summary: Council motion asking for policy recommendations on regulating algorithmic rent-setting and AI tools used by apartment landlords.
